Nonogram generation and logical solver: monkeyArms/nonogram
https://github.com/monkeyArms/nonogram — MIT (nonogram/LICENSE.txt).
Source modules retained; import paths adjusted. Puzzle collection generated locally.
Mahjong layout definitions and free-tile/removal-sequence algorithms: tcottrill/myMahjong
https://github.com/tcottrill/myMahjong — Unlicense (mahjong/LICENSE.txt).
Adapted for deterministic deals and guaranteed-solvable shuffles; removed unsolvable fallback.
All tile-face artwork in this arcade adaptation is original procedural SVG.
Reversi rules and AI: goshrum/p2p-reversi
https://github.com/goshrum/p2p-reversi — MIT (reversi/LICENSE.txt).
TypeScript stripped to JavaScript; terminal AI scoring corrected to prioritize wins.
New arcade interfaces, saves and server-validated online matches added locally.
